name: Gousawa Gisuke
source:
Keiichi's classmate, the son of local influential anti-society force.
Even though he's an alpha he's not an elite.

Likes to bully Fuwatari.

Is sometimes misunderstood because of his rough behavior.

Attribute: Alpha (α)
